column8: \paragraph{Refined negative-weight subtraction.} Refinement used the unfold's deterministic GBDT configuration, independent injection and subtraction halves of background simulation, and bootstrap replicas that individually resampled every pseudo-event and refit refinement. It preserves the signed total to $3\times10^{-6}$ and clips \SIrange{0.01}{0.05}{\percent} of events. Corner bias falls from \SI{1.66}{\percent} to \SI{0.24}{\percent}, but residuals in some joint cells fail the nominal closure criterion. The criterion has two parts, each applied to all 153 reported quantities. No quantity may have a mean residual beyond 3.6 standard errors of the mean ($|t|>3.6$), a fixed threshold at about the two-sided 5\% level for a normal reference, Bonferroni-corrected over the 153. Nor may any quantity have a mean residual beyond half its bootstrap standard deviation with $|t|>3$. The data difference's sign pattern matches simulated purity bias at an order of magnitude smaller size; the difference is method sensitivity, not a measured bias. With either treatment, the estimator does not follow generator-sized $\Eavail$ shape changes. This refinement study ran no coverage test. Reducing one bias does not itself qualify an uncertainty, so this result does not close the revisit of the background treatment of the \resFiveAxis{} (\S\ref{sec:negweight-footing}).
